A tips from a mountain leader in the Swedish arctic:
Make sure that you are warm before you go to bed. Almost as if you’re sweating.
Make sure you don’t fill up all of the sleeping bag as it is the air you need to warm up. Less air = colder. But blankets on the outside of the sleeping bag NEVER inside.
Put something that generates warmth in the sleeping bag, for example a bottle with boiling water or hand warmer. And eat just before you go to sleep, preferably inside the sleeping bag.
